note: Authored synthetic corpus. Each question names the page that answers it, or none when the files can't answer it. Exact-term questions favour keyword search; paraphrases favour vector search.

documents.title: aurora-water-report.pdf
pages: Aurora Lake Water Authority. Quarterly water quality report for the third quarter. The authority serves 182,000 residents across four districts.
Turbidity. Average turbidity in the third quarter was 0.37 NTU, below the regulatory limit of 1.0 NTU. The highest single reading, 0.82 NTU, followed heavy rain on 14 August.
Maintenance. Crews replaced 12 membrane modules at the Eastside treatment plant in September. Filtration uptime was 98.6 percent for the quarter.
Chlorine. Residual chlorine stayed between 0.4 and 1.2 mg/L at every sampling point. No boil-water notices were issued.

documents.title: vendor-contract-ax17.pdf
pages: Supply agreement AX-17 between Northwind Components and Aurora Lake Water Authority. The vendor delivers 400 pump seals per month.
Pricing. Each unit costs INR 1,250. Prices are fixed for 24 months and then indexed to the wholesale price index.
Payment and termination. Invoices are payable within 30 days. Either party may terminate with 90 days written notice. Late deliveries incur a penalty of 2 percent per week.

documents.title: onboarding-handbook.pdf
pages: Welcome. New employees complete security training in their first week and receive a laptop on day one.
Leave policy. Staff accrue 1.5 days of paid annual leave per month. Up to 10 unused days carry over into the next calendar year.
Remote work. Employees may work remotely up to three days a week with their manager's approval. Core collaboration hours are 11:00 to 15:00.

documents.title: solar-pilot-results.pdf
pages: Rooftop solar pilot. Forty panels were installed on the Westside depot roof in March.
Results. The array produced 21.4 MWh over six months, covering 38 percent of the depot's electricity use. Payback is estimated at 7 years.
